statement.text:
Conjecture: Let G be a finite group, p a prime number, and P a Sylow p-
subgroup of G. Suppose that an irreducible ordinary character χ of G has degree
divisible by p. If the restriction χP of χ to P has a linear constituent, then χP has
at least p different linear constituents.
    This conjecture has been verified for symmetric, alternating, p-solvable, and spo-
radic simple groups.                                                       E. Giannelli
